source: AssetDump class-default exports in Phoenix GameServer/.atlas_cache/dumps
derivation: Init path recomputes AttackVectorsN_Simple = SimplifyVectors(AttackVectorsN, 100.0) unconditionally after hit-area setup, overwriting serialized _Simple
Evaluate: SimplifiedAttackVectorsN = AttackVectorsN_Simple * GetScalingFactor (BehemothScale when ScaleHitAreaToBehemothSize, DebugScale when non-zero, else 1)

Evaluate rejects when PathHitsNavMesh(path, NavFilter_ExcludeBehemoth_C, extent 100,100,1024, TargetActor=current target) hits with PathPercentageBeforeHit < 0.9, for either path with more than one point
openQuestions: TargetActor suppression with a nav agent is unconfirmed: Default__Character placed 0..250 units from 12 native hit points never suppressed, so either its agent radius is not positive or the agent lookup returns nothing for a class default object. Confirm with a live pawn target and record the player nav agent radius.
Runtime behemoth nav modifiers (areas 3, 5, 6, 7) around live behemoths are not captured; the static mesh has none.
nativeFindings: SimplifyVectors (UFunction on BP_BehemothAction_C, called natively on its default object with epsilon 100) reproduces the literal decompiled algorithm on 538/538 dumped AttackVectors arrays: 2D infinite-line distance, interior candidates only, divide-by-zero distance 0, and both recursion halves are points[0..split], so points after the first split are discarded. Serialized AttackVectorsN_Simple matches only 110/538 and is overwritten at runtime.

Runtime area table on RecastNavMesh-Behemoth: area 4 is BP_Nav_BreakableTree_C; NavFilter_ExcludeBehemoth_C excludes ids 6 and 7, which no static polygon uses. 675 PathHitsNavMesh reruns with NavFilter_ExcludeBehemoth_C equal NoDynamic in hit, found and percentage.
TargetActor at the path start (9 placed actors, 74 rays, hits 91..3905 units from the target) never changed hit or OutPathPercentageBeforeHit.

Multi-segment PathHitsNavMesh (60 three-point cases: out-and-back, in-out, out-further): the segment loop stops at the first hit; OutPathPercentageBeforeHit = distance before the hit / length of the segments walked including the hitting one. Phoenix DetourNavMesh.path_query reproduces hit, found and percentage exactly on all 957 native queries (675 single-segment, 60 multi-segment, 222 target rays).

Disassembly (RVA 0x26E125B..0x26E1360): with a TargetActor, a hit is suppressed when the 2D distance from the hit point to the target's RootComponent ComponentToWorld translation is below the square root of the target's nav agent property float at offset 4 (AgentRadius), read through a virtual call; actors without a nav agent use 0 and never suppress.
